display.usage: Singular page statements and expressive product moments.

page-title.usage: Section hierarchy and important grouped content.

body.usage: Reading text, explanations, and form guidance.

eyebrow.usage: Compact labels, metadata, and interface wayfinding.

telemetry.usage: Telemetry, counters, and technical evidence with tabular numerals.

section-title.usage: Ruled panel and operational section headings.

compact-interface.usage: Dense controls, table content, and persistent operational context.

2.usage: Compact control internals and paired labels.

8.usage: Major sections and page level separation.

layout.guidance: Keep operational context visible, align dense panels to ruled columns, and reserve open space for active work.

mobile.guidance: Use one content column and preserve source order.

tablet.guidance: Introduce paired regions only when each remains independently readable.

desktop.guidance: Use the full grid while keeping reading lines constrained.

zoom.guidance: Allow controls and content to wrap without clipping or overlap.

reflow.guidance: Retain every action and meaning in a single logical flow.

control.usage: Buttons, fields, and compact interactive surfaces.

panel.usage: Cards, panels, and larger grouped regions.

strong.usage: Selected, focused, or strongly separated regions.

flat.usage: Default surfaces separated by spacing or borders.

overlay.usage: Dialogs, menus, and content above the working plane.

buttons.guidance: Keep actions compact, instrument like, and explicit about the operation they trigger.

states.default: Use dense geometry and an operation first label.
states.hover: Increase emphasis without changing the control footprint.
states.focus: Use an unmistakable focus outline outside the ruled edge.
states.active: Show immediate pressed feedback without layout movement.
states.disabled: Preserve the operation name while removing activation.
states.loading: Keep the operation visible with an explicit running status.
states.success: Report the completed operation with text and success color.
states.error: Report the failed operation with text and destructive color.

links.guidance: Use precise destination names, persistent underlines, and visible keyboard focus.

states.hover: Increase emphasis without moving surrounding telemetry.
states.focus: Use the same high visibility outline as controls.
states.active: Maintain the destination text through activation.
states.disabled: Render unavailable destinations as status text.
states.loading: Expose running status beside the destination.
states.success: Report successful local resolution in adjacent text.
states.error: Report failed local resolution in adjacent text.

forms.guidance: Align labels, fields, help, and validation as persistent operational context.
forms.help: The alert address receives the local check summary.

inputs.textareaPlaceholder: List the conditions this check should evaluate.
inputs.guidance: Use compact controls, persistent labels, and reserved validation rows to prevent panel movement.

cards.title: Current run
cards.description: A dense operational card keeps status, telemetry, and the next action in one scan path.
cards.guidance: Use cards for one operational object and keep state visible before action.

panels.title: Execution context
panels.description: Persistent context stays bounded beside the changing working surface.
panels.guidance: Use ruled panels for durable context and align telemetry to predictable columns.

navigation.label: Console sections
navigation.guidance: Expose the current console section in text and aria current while preserving keyboard sequence.

listItems.title: Interval
listItems.description: Checks execute on a fixed local specimen clock.

dataDisplay.guidance: Align operational values into dense ruled columns with persistent row headings.
dataDisplay.overflowGuidance: Expose horizontal overflow on a labelled region while preserving every operational column.

badges.label: Idle
badges.meaning: The check is not currently running

badges.label: Passing
badges.meaning: The latest result met its threshold

badges.label: Failed
badges.meaning: The latest result crossed its failure threshold

alerts.title: All checks recovered
alerts.description: The current run has returned to healthy thresholds.

alerts.title: Job error rate failed
alerts.description: Inspect Run 042 before acknowledging the incident.

states.empty: No checks are configured for this target.
states.filteredEmpty: No checks match the active result filter.
states.error: Check results could not be read. Retry the local run.
states.disabled: Acknowledge is unavailable until the run completes.
states.destructive: Deleting this check removes it from the local run plan.

feedback.guidance: Report the operation, result, and next action in one compact scan path.
feedback.nonColorGuidance: Pair semantic color with a written result, symbol, and ruled treatment.

dialogs.title: Inspect run summary
dialogs.description: Review Run 042 telemetry before returning to the checks grid.
dialogs.guidance: Keep the operation and current run identifier visible throughout the dialog.
dialogs.escapeBehavior: Escape closes inspection because no operational change is pending.
dialogs.focusRestoration: Return focus to the run summary control.

destructiveActions.consequence: The check will be removed from the local Run 042 plan.
destructiveActions.recoverability: This specimen can restore the check because it performs no external operation.
destructiveActions.guidance: Repeat the exact check name and operational consequence before confirmation.

motion.guidance: Use fast operational transitions that confirm input without delaying the next action.

reducedMotion.guidance: Remove translation and scaling while preserving an immediate labelled state change.

accessibility.semantics: Use native landmarks, headings, controls, tables, lists, and status regions before adding ARIA.
accessibility.keyboard: Keep every action reachable and operable in a logical source and tab order.
accessibility.focus: Show a persistent high contrast focus indicator and restore focus after modal interactions.
accessibility.contrast: Meet text, icon, control boundary, and state contrast in both supported color schemes.
accessibility.targetSize: Provide targets at least 24 by 24 CSS pixels with adequate spacing between adjacent actions.
accessibility.zoom: Preserve content and operation at 200 percent page zoom without overlap or clipping.
accessibility.reflow: Reflow to a 320 CSS pixel viewport without two dimensional page scrolling.
accessibility.forcedColors: Retain boundaries, focus, selection, and status meaning when system colors replace authored colors.
accessibility.statusCommunication: Announce asynchronous and local state changes in named status or alert regions without relying on color.
